claim.quote: We focus especially on the background coming from {sup 222}Rn daughters. This is found to be at present by a factor of 200 higher than expected from simulation. It is still compatible with the scientific goal of GENIUS-TF, namely to search for cold dark matter by the modulation signal

name: The GENIUS-test-facility: first results on background from 222Rn daughters

published.quote: Journal Name: Nuclear Instruments and Methods in Physics Research. Section A, Accelerators, Spectrometers, Detectors and Associated Equipment; Journal Volume: 530; Journal Issue: 3

summary.plain: The first background analysis of the GENIUS-TF test facility found radon-daughter background 200 times above the simulation, still low enough for its dark matter goal.
summary.technical: Background from 222Rn daughters after the completion of the external shielding (December 2003), a factor of about 200 above the simulation; compatible with the annual-modulation search but a serious problem for a full-size liquid-nitrogen GENIUS.

title: The GENIUS-test-facility: first results on background from 222Rn daughters
why_it_matters: Told the field that naked germanium in liquid nitrogen needs much cleaner nitrogen and shielding than simulated.
